purpose: Credential-free probe to run after every Render change (deploy, env var edit, plan change). Guardrail (b), operator request 2026-11-14. Every header value below is a dummy; no probe needs or may carry a real credential.

service.name: bds_website
service.health_path_note: Recommended Render healthCheckPath. Not yet set in the dashboard (KI-BDS-20261114-001).

retry.note: The service and ForgeCustomer spin down when idle. Retry a 502/503/504 that is not a listed misconfigured signature up to 4 times with 2/4/8/8 s waits before reporting a failure (KI-BDS-20261002-002).

probes.misconfigured_signature: None. Liveness only proves the process answers; it never reflects configuration.

503 with status "not_ready" and failed[] naming each setting and a reason code (missing, malformed, insecure_scheme, has_credentials, has_query_or_fragment, has_path, host_not_allowed, secret_key_shape, role_not_anon, project_mismatch). advisory[] entries (BDS_INTAKE_URL) never fail readiness. No value is ever in the body.
None for configuration: the static site serves even when readiness fails. A non-200 here is an outage, not a config fault.

probes.redaction: supabaseAnonKey is public by design, but record only whether it is empty and whether it starts with sb_publishable_; do not paste it into a ticket.
probes.misconfigured_signature: Still 200, but supabaseUrl or supabaseAnonKey is "" (unset, or withheld because the value failed its shape check, for example a secret key) or forgeConfigured is false.

503 INTEGRATION_UNCONFIGURED or 503 FORGECUSTOMER_API_BASE_INVALID / _INSECURE / _HOST_NOT_ALLOWED (website config); 502 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE (wrong or unreachable host); 5xx passed through from ForgeCustomer.

probes.note: The dummy bearer passes the BFF shape check and reaches ForgeCustomer, which must refuse it. Observed 2026-11-14: 401 INVALID_TOKEN.
probes.misconfigured_signature: 503 INTEGRATION_UNCONFIGURED when FORGECUSTOMER_API_BASE is unset; 503 FORGECUSTOMER_API_BASE_INVALID when it has a path or bad syntax; 502 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE for a wrong host; 500 from ForgeCustomer means its own auth configuration is broken (the 2026-11-14 failure class).

source_evidence: server/readiness.ts: readinessReport() checks and reason codes
server/security/http.ts: normalizeBearerAuthorization() bearer shape, parseConfiguredBaseUrl() error codes
tests/readiness.test.ts: valid, missing, malformed, secret-shaped and no-leak cases
